description: Wi-Fi + Bluetooth manager for the built-in radio and a USB dongle side by side.

store.title: DualRadio
store.summary: Built-in + USB Wi-Fi/Bluetooth manager: monitor mode, survey, hotspot, BT pairing
store.description:
Manage the CardputerZero's built-in radio and a USB Wi-Fi/Bluetooth dongle side by side.

Wi-Fi
- Connect, disconnect each radio or both; per-radio saved networks (compatible with WiFi USB's <ifname>-<ssid> profiles); passwords remembered and reused across radios.
- Scan with 2.4/5 GHz band filter and full network details: channel, width, 802.11 standard, WPA2/WPA3/PMF, ciphers, clients and channel load, WPS router model, every AP/BSSID with vendor.
- Choose the main network other apps use (route metrics); auto-fallback to built-in Wi-Fi when the dongle is unplugged.
- Monitor mode on the dongle with an all-band AP survey (band, channel, RSSI, security, clients), channel lock and pcap capture for Wireshark.
- Hotspot from the built-in radio sharing the dongle's connection; ping and download speed test per radio.
- Overlapping 2.4 GHz channel warning when both radios share the band.

Bluetooth (built-in and dongle separately)
- Classic + BLE scan with live RSSI; details: class, appearance, services, manufacturer, iBeacon/Apple/Microsoft adverts, distance estimate.
- Pair (on-screen passkey confirm/PIN), connect, trust, remove; signal 'hunt' view to locate a device.

Esc = back, hold Esc = exit.
